name: AAdvantage Aviator Red World Elite

apr.notes: Variable APR 21.24% to 29.99% for purchases and balance transfers. 0% introductory APR for 15 months on balance transfers made within 45 days of account opening. APRs vary with Prime Rate.

credit_required.notes: Good to excellent credit recommended. Card may be closed to new applications as of late 2025 with Citi taking over AA portfolio in 2026.

base_rate.description: 1X AAdvantage mile for every $1 spent on all other purchases

rewards.redemption_notes: No limit to the number of AAdvantage miles you can earn. Miles earn 1 Loyalty Point per $1 spent toward AAdvantage status. American Airlines miles expire 24 months after last account activity.

signup_bonus.description: 60,000 AAdvantage bonus miles after making your first purchase and paying the annual fee in full, both within the first 90 days. No minimum spend required beyond first purchase.

benefits.title: First Checked Bag Free
benefits.description: First checked bag free on domestic American Airlines itineraries for the primary cardmember and up to 4 companions on the same reservation.

benefits.title: Inflight Wi-Fi Statement Credits
benefits.description: Up to $25 back as statement credits on inflight Wi-Fi purchases every anniversary year on American Airlines operated flights.

benefits.title: 25% Inflight Savings
benefits.description: 25% inflight savings as statement credits on food and beverages when you use your card on American Airlines operated flights.

benefits.title: Anniversary Companion Certificate
benefits.description: Earned each anniversary year with qualifying purchases of $20,000+ and account remains open 45 days after anniversary. Companion certificate allows 1 guest at $99 plus taxes and fees.

benefits.title: Preferred Boarding
benefits.description: Preferred boarding (Group 5) for primary cardmember and up to 4 companions on the same reservation on American Airlines flights.

benefits.title: Earn AAdvantage Loyalty Points
benefits.description: Earn 1 Loyalty Point for every $1 spent on the card toward AAdvantage status.

benefits.title: Travel Accident Insurance
benefits.description: Travel Accident Insurance coverage when you purchase travel tickets with your card.

benefits.title: Trip Cancellation and Interruption Coverage
benefits.description: Trip Cancellation and Interruption coverage when you purchase travel with your card.

benefits.title: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver coverage when you rent a vehicle with your card.

travel_perks.free_checked_bags: First checked bag free on domestic American Airlines itineraries for primary cardmember and up to 4 companions on same reservation
